questions.stem: 垂直農場（vertical farms）在城市大樓裡種植蔬菜，但這種方式是否比傳統農業更環保仍有爭議。
questions.answer: Vertical farms grow vegetables inside urban buildings, but whether this method is more environmentally friendly than traditional agriculture remains controversial.
accepted_answers: Vertical farms grow vegetables in city buildings, but people still disagree about whether this way of farming is better for the environment than traditional agriculture.
Vertical farms grow vegetables inside buildings in cities, but it is still debated whether this approach is greener than traditional farming.

patterns: 間接問句（whether 名詞子句：這種方式是否…）
比較級（比傳統農業更環保）

questions.stem: 城市人口愈多，就愈需要在地生產的蔬菜，促使許多城市投資興建垂直農場。
questions.answer: The more people a city has, the more it needs locally grown vegetables, prompting many cities to invest in building vertical farms.
accepted_answers: The larger a city's population is, the more locally grown vegetables it needs, leading many cities to invest in vertical farms.
The bigger the population of a city, the greater its need for locally produced vegetables, encouraging many cities to invest in building vertical farms.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（…，促使許多城市…）
愈…愈…（城市人口愈多，就愈需要…）

1.explanation_zh: 前半句是簡單的主動句 Vertical farms grow vegetables inside urban buildings（「城市大樓」是 urban／city buildings，複數）。後半句「這種方式是否比傳統農業更環保」是名詞子句，用 whether 引導、直述句語序，可以直接當主詞：whether this method is … remains controversial；也可以寫成 it is still debated whether …。「更環保」的「環保」是形容詞概念，寫 more environmentally friendly、greener 或 better for the environment，再接 than traditional agriculture／farming。「仍有爭議」是 remains controversial。
evidence: 垂直農場（vertical farms）在城市大樓裡種植蔬菜
這種方式是否比傳統農業更環保仍有爭議
1.strategy_zh: 後半句先決定外框（whether … remains controversial 或 it is still debated whether …），再把比較級 more … than … 放進 whether 子句。
hints: 切成四段：在城市大樓裡種植蔬菜／這種方式是否／比傳統農業更環保／仍有爭議
標的詞彙：vegetable（蔬菜）、building（大樓）、environmentally friendly（環保的）、traditional（傳統的）、debate／controversial（爭議）
句型框架：S + V …, but whether + S + be + more + adj. + than + N + remains controversial

2.explanation_zh: 「愈…愈…」用 The + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V：The more people a city has, the more it needs …；兩個子句都要有主詞與動詞，後半句的主詞「城市」中文省略了，英文要補 it。「在地生產的蔬菜」是 locally grown／locally produced vegetables（副詞修飾過去分詞）。「促使許多城市投資…」是結果，用句尾分詞 prompting／leading many cities to invest in …，invest 後面接 in。
evidence: 城市人口愈多，就愈需要在地生產的蔬菜
促使許多城市投資興建垂直農場
2.strategy_zh: 先寫出 The more …, the more … 的骨架，確認兩邊都有主詞動詞；再用 V-ing 片語接上結果。
hints: 切成四段：城市人口愈多／就愈需要在地生產的蔬菜／促使許多城市／投資興建垂直農場
標的詞彙：population（人口）、local（在地的）、vegetable（蔬菜）、invest（投資）
句型框架：The more + N + S + V, the more + S + V …, prompting + O + to VR …

common_errors.explanation_zh: 名詞子句用直述句語序：whether + 主詞 + 動詞。

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「環保」在這裡是形容詞（對環境友善），不是名詞 environmental protection。
greener 已經是比較級，不能再加 more。

people still disagree about

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「有爭議」用形容詞 controversial 或 be debated，不說 have controversy。
「被爭論」要用被動 it is still debated。

traps.literal_error: this method is more environmental protection than traditional farming
traps.explanation_zh: 「環保」在這裡當形容詞用（對環境友善），英文用 environmentally friendly、green 或 better for the environment；直譯成名詞 environmental protection 會變成「這種方式是環境保護」。

traps.zh: 這種方式是否比傳統農業更環保仍有爭議
traps.literal_error: this method whether is more environmentally friendly than traditional farming still has controversy
traps.explanation_zh: 中文拿整個「是否…」問句當主詞；英文要先用 whether 把問句變成名詞子句（直述句語序），才能當主詞，或放在 it is still debated 後面。

1.restructuring_zh: 「這種方式是否…仍有爭議」以問句當主詞，英文要改成 whether 名詞子句（直述句語序）當主詞，或改用 it is still debated whether … 把子句移到句尾；「更環保」的「環保」要改成形容詞 environmentally friendly。

traps.explanation_zh: 「在地生產的」是複合概念，英文用 locally grown／locally produced（副詞＋過去分詞）修飾 vegetables，或直接說 local vegetables；production 不能當形容詞放在名詞前。

traps.literal_error: The more people a city has, the more need locally grown vegetables.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文後半句省略了主詞（城市）；英文「愈…愈…」兩個子句都要有主詞和動詞：the more it needs …。

bonus.text: So great is the demand for locally grown vegetables in crowded cities that many of them have begun investing in vertical farms.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + adj. + be + S + that … 的倒裝句強調需求之大；只當加分寫法。

2.restructuring_zh: 「城市人口愈多，就愈需要…」後半句省略主詞，英文要補上 it（＝the city），並把兩個比較級移到句首形成 The more …, the more …；「促使…」改成句尾分詞 prompting many cities to …。

2.translation: The larger a city's population is, the more locally produced vegetables it needs, prompting many cities to invest in building vertical farms.
